Loop.name: Loop
Loop.description: Chicago's historic central business district featuring major commercial towers, Millennium Park, and adaptive residential conversions.

Fulton Market.name: Fulton Market
Fulton Market.description: Former meatpacking district transformed into premier tech headquarters, Michelin-starred dining, and luxury mid-rise development.

River North.name: River North
River North.description: High-density entertainment and design district with prominent art galleries, luxury high-rises, and vibrant nightlife.

Streeterville.name: Streeterville
Streeterville.description: Lakefront high-rise neighborhood home to Northwestern Memorial Hospital, Magnificent Mile shopping, and Navy Pier.

South Loop.name: South Loop
South Loop.description: Cultural campus gateway near Museum Campus with extensive residential high-rise infill and transit connectivity.

West Loop.name: West Loop
West Loop.description: Vibrant dining and creative office corridor along Randolph Street with extensive timber loft and high-density residential projects.

Lincoln Park.name: Lincoln Park
Lincoln Park.description: Affluent historic lakefront neighborhood with historic rowhouses, DePaul University, and prime retail along Armitage and Halsted.

Lakeview.name: Lakeview
Lakeview.description: Dense, vibrant North Side community encompassing Wrigleyville and Boystown with high pedestrian activity and entertainment.

Old Town.name: Old Town
Old Town.description: Historic Victorian neighborhood known for Wells Street dining, comedy clubs (The Second City), and boutique streetscapes.

Roscoe Village.name: Roscoe Village
Roscoe Village.description: 'Village in the City' with tree-lined streets, local shops on Roscoe Street, and family-oriented multifamily infill.

Lincoln Square.name: Lincoln Square
Lincoln Square.description: German-heritage commercial square with brick-paved pedestrian corridors, independent retailers, and cultural anchors.

North Center.name: North Center
North Center.description: Thriving North Side residential enclave with top-rated school districts, craft breweries, and steady residential redevelopment.

Wicker Park.name: Wicker Park
Wicker Park.description: Creative and commercial corridor centered at Six Corners (Milwaukee/Damen/North) with vibrant nightlife, dining, and boutique retail.

Bucktown.name: Bucktown
Bucktown.description: Trendy residential and retail district along the Bloomingdale Trail (The 606) with modern residential architectural conversions.

Logan Square.name: Logan Square
Logan Square.description: Historic boulevard district experiencing rapid transit-oriented development, artisanal cocktail lounges, and culinary renewal.

Avondale.name: Avondale
Avondale.description: Industrial-to-creative transition zone along Belmont and Milwaukee avenues with acclaimed dining and craft manufacturing.

West Town.name: West Town
West Town.description: Dynamic mixed-use community along Chicago Avenue featuring design showrooms, independent galleries, and residential conversions.

Humboldt Park.name: Humboldt Park
Humboldt Park.description: Cultural hub centered around the 207-acre park and Paseo Boricua with expanding commercial and residential rehabilitation.

Ukrainian Village.name: Ukrainian Village
Ukrainian Village.description: Historic brick rowhouse and cathedral district with mature tree canopy and active commercial nodes on Chicago Avenue.

Rogers Park.name: Rogers Park
Rogers Park.description: Lakefront academic anchor community at Chicago's northern border with Loyola University and diverse multifamily housing.

Edgewater.name: Edgewater
Edgewater.description: Scenic shoreline neighborhood featuring high-rise lakefront condos, antique shopping on Broadway, and historic Bryn Mawr.

Andersonville.name: Andersonville
Andersonville.description: Historic Swedish-heritage commercial district along Clark Street famous for locally-owned independent businesses and vibrant dining.

Uptown.name: Uptown
Uptown.description: Historic entertainment and theater district anchored by the Riviera, Aragon Ballroom, and major transit infrastructure upgrades.

Albany Park.name: Albany Park
Albany Park.description: Multicultural commercial core along Lawrence Avenue with extensive culinary diversity and Brown Line terminus connectivity.

Hyde Park.name: Hyde Park
Hyde Park.description: Prestigious academic and institutional hub anchored by the University of Chicago, Museum of Science & Industry, and 53rd St retail.

Bronzeville.name: Bronzeville
Bronzeville.description: Historic Black Metropolis seeing massive mixed-use revitalization, historic greystone restorations, and Bronzeville Lakefront redevelopment.

Kenwood.name: Kenwood
Kenwood.description: Historic residential district featuring grand mansions, leafy boulevards, and proximity to Lake Michigan parkland.

Woodlawn.name: Woodlawn
Woodlawn.description: South Side community adjacent to Jackson Park and the Obama Presidential Center with accelerating residential investments.

Chinatown.name: Chinatown
Chinatown.description: Bustling cultural and gastronomic destination centered on Wentworth and Archer avenues with high commercial density.

Bridgeport.name: Bridgeport
Bridgeport.description: Historic working-class neighborhood evolving into an arts and culinary corridor with Bridgeport Art Center and Morgan Street retail.

Pilsen.name: Pilsen
Pilsen.description: Vibrant cultural corridor along 18th Street known for historic murals, award-winning culinary scene, and creative adaptive reuse.

McKinley Park.name: McKinley Park
McKinley Park.description: Centrally located southwest neighborhood with strong park anchor, Orange Line transit access, and industrial-loft conversions.

Brighton Park.name: Brighton Park
Brighton Park.description: Densely populated commercial district along Archer Avenue with steady neighborhood retail and logistics services.

Little Village.name: Little Village
Little Village.description: 'Mexico of the Midwest' featuring 26th Street, one of the highest grossing shopping districts in Chicago, with vibrant street commerce.

Back of the Yards.name: Back of the Yards
Back of the Yards.description: Historic Union Stockyards heritage district undergoing modern sustainable manufacturing, food innovation, and community development.
